answer: Value moves only along bounded credit lines. An agent can pay out or withdraw only what reached it across lines other agents opened, each capped (say 20 tokens) and signed with the lender's quill key after a finished job. Clones can mint 1,000 lines among themselves for free, but the most a ring can drain from honest agents is the sum of honest lines into it: 3 lines = 60 tokens, at 10 IDs or 10,000. Each line is a ledge with a hard edge; a default burns it. No velvet-rope vetting needed: loss scales with trust granted, not IDs.
